title: Awrad change queue (sync v1)
description: Wire shapes of the change queue: commands, receipts, changes and the entity documents: three of slice 3b, with the uploaded recordings of slice 3c, the practice policy of slice 3d (urn:awrad:practice-settings:1), and the goal and goal order of slice 4 (urn:awrad:goal-model:1). Protocol rules, and the limits a schema can't express (64 KB per document, tag-name graphemes and bytes, normalized_name recomputation, account limits, audio assets being ready and matching, a goal's dhikr existing, the goal rules a schema can't express): README.md. A batch whose envelope breaks this schema is a 422; a command whose document breaks it is a `rejected` receipt.

uuid.description: Lowercase, hyphenated UUID, any version except nil and max (contracts/identity/v1/fixtures/uuid_format.json). IDs we generate are UUIDv7.

int53.description: A non-negative JSON integer up to 2^53 - 1 (contracts/api/STYLE.md §5).

entity_type.description: practice_policy (slice 3d) and goal_order (slice 4) are one per account, with the account ID as their entity_id. A goal (slice 4) has a new UUIDv7.

op.description: `put` creates (base_version 0) or replaces the whole document; `delete` makes a final tombstone.

version.description: Per-entity version: 0 means the entity doesn't exist yet, and every applied change (including a delete or a server-side cascade) adds one.

revision.description: Per-account revision. Every applied command takes the next one; its cascades share it.

custom_dhikr_document.description: A user's own dhikr: urn:awrad:dhikr-catalog:1#/$defs/dhikr without id (the entity_id is the ID), key, virtues, aliases or catalog tags (user tags live in dhikr_personal). Every language key is always present, null when empty; the title needs at least one. Audio is null, a marker that a recording exists on the device that made it, or an uploaded recording (slice 3c). Lengths count Unicode code points. One rule this schema can't express: a Qur'an reference's ayah_end must be at least its ayah_start (field error `range` on /references/N/ayah_end; fixtures/custom_dhikr_validity.json).

title.description: Every language key is present (STYLE §3), null when the user gave none; at least one is text, because the user writes the title in their own language. Apps show the app language, then en, then any.

transliteration.description: en and ml, each text or null. Arabic has none.

translation.description: en, ar and ml, each text or null.

audio.description: null (no recording), {"local_only": true} (a recording kept only on the device that imported it) or an uploaded recording (slice 3c). Any other shape is a field error `invalid` on /audio.

local_audio.description: A recording that exists only on the device that imported it: signed out, offline, or not uploaded yet (slice 3b). Other devices and the web show no audio.

uploaded_audio.description: A recording uploaded to the account's private storage (slice 3c, contracts/audio/v1). Every member is present (STYLE §3). The server applies a put naming it only when asset_id is a ready asset of the account; otherwise the put is `rejected` with audio_not_found. byte_size and content_type must equal the asset's, or the put is `rejected` with audio_mismatch (a `mismatch` field error on each disagreeing member). duration_ms is the importing client's measurement, or null.

tag_name.description: Display name: trimmed, inner White_Space runs collapsed to one space, NFC. 1-40 extended grapheme clusters and at most 128 UTF-8 bytes (README.md; fixtures/tag_name_normalization.json). The schema can only bound code points.

user_tag_document.description: A user's tag. The server recomputes normalized_name from name and rejects a mismatch; two active tags never share a normalized_name.

normalized_name.description: Unicode Default Case Folding of name, then NFC. Full case folding can lengthen a name, so this bound is looser than name's.

dhikr_personal_document.description: A user's own data about one dhikr (built-in or custom); its entity_id is the dhikr's ID. For now only its tags, in the user's order. Clients clear tags with an empty list; they never delete this entity.

document.description: Any of the six entity documents.

command_envelope.description: What every command in a batch must look like for the batch to be accepted: a batch with a command that breaks this is a 422 and nothing is applied. The document only has to be an object here; its content is checked per command, and a bad one is a `rejected` receipt.

command_id.description: A new UUIDv7 per command. Its receipt is kept for 90 days; resending the same command replays it.

base_version.description: The entity version this command was made on: 0 to create.

document.description: The whole new document. Required for put, absent for delete.

command.description: A valid command: the envelope plus the document schema of its entity_type. Applied in batch order; each gets one receipt.

command_batch.description: The body of post_sync_commands. 0 or more than 100 commands, or any command that breaks command_envelope, is a 422.

current.description: The server's current copy of the command's entity, as receipts carry it.

field_error.description: One problem with a command. field is a JSON Pointer into the command (for example /document/title/en). `range`: a value is out of order with another, such as a Qur'an reference whose ayah_end is below its ayah_start (on ayah_end). `immutable`: a goal's dhikr_id or counts differs from the stored goal's (goal_field_immutable).

notice_code.description: Why a phone tells the user something changed: a rejection code; hijri_corrections_replaced when merging a conflicting practice_policy dropped this phone's Hijri corrections (practice-settings/v1 practice_policy_merge); or goal_edit_not_applied when a goal edit lost to another device's, so the phone took the server's goal and offers to retry (decision 44).

cascaded_change.description: An entity the server changed as a cascade of the receipt's command, at the same revision: a dhikr_personal that a user_tag delete removed the tag from (active); or, for a deleted custom_dhikr, its dhikr_personal (deleted) and each of its goals that hadn't ended, now ended with reason dhikr_deleted (active). The phone sets its known version from it; the document is in the changes feed.

applied_receipt.description: cascaded is an array exactly when the command is a user_tag or custom_dhikr delete: every other entity the server changed at the same revision, ordered by entity_type, then entity_id, and empty when nothing cascaded. For every other command it is null.

merged_receipt.description: A user_tag create whose normalized_name an active tag already has. The new ID becomes an alias of merged_into; current is that tag.

rejected_receipt.description: current is the entity as the server has it, so the client can undo to it; null when the server has no such entity.

outcome.description: A receipt as first decided, which a duplicate replays.

receipt_batch.description: The response of post_sync_commands: one receipt per command, in the same order.

change.description: An entity's latest state in the changes feed (and a row of server state in the fixtures). document is null when deleted.

changes_page.description: The response of list_sync_changes. Ordered by revision, then entity_type, then entity_id. A page never splits a revision.
